title: Page 3
content_zh:
而玄昱显然很厚待谢雍，直接把位于尊贵豪华地段的一座偌大府邸赏踢给了谢家，并且将之变成了谢家的祖产，官府将来不会收回。

谢府虽然清贵，但还是无法和当今第一世家的原府相提并论，谢府面积相对小很多，是一座七进的宅子，前三进属于外宅，后四进则属于女眷居住的内院，颇为宽敞的后花园位于第六进，第七进则是女仆们居住的后罩房，后罩房隔一条窄巷外就是临街的高墙了。

谢母的院落松鹤园位于第五进，最是疏朗轩阔，而且临近后花园，便于老人家散心。

谢雍与原宜之的新房位于第四进的正院清越园，正院东西两侧各有一个附属院落，分别住着谢雍的两个妻室玲珑和青黛。

谢雍日后如果再有了儿女，女儿长大些可以搬进第六进后花园中的闺楼，而儿子长大了，则要移居到第三进的外宅，这就是严格的男女有别。

今日谢雍续弦大婚，其排场并不亚于当年他迎娶丁锦绣，丁锦绣的父亲虽然曾为宰相，但还是无法和原家的势力相比，只是丁锦绣是嫡女原配，今天的原宜之是庶女续弦，名义与位分上总显得弱一些，但是今天来的客人却比当年还多。

谢雍还在前庭招待纷纷扰扰的各路宾客，原宜之在小丫鬟的带领下已走进谢母居住的松鹤园。

谢母居住在堂屋的东里间，此时她正躺在大床上，身后靠着厚厚的大迎枕，额头上盖着布巾，脸色有些苍白，气色倒真的是不太好。

谢雍的父亲去世时，谢母才三十二岁，到如今守寡已十七年，一个妇道人家辛辛苦苦地把儿子拉扯大，眼看就要到知天命之年，儿子却非要娶一个‘扫把星’进门，谢母觉得自己没被气死已是命大。

谢母身高瘦削，头发已经花白，但是梳理得很整齐，即便是躺在床上，头发也纹丝不乱。她的眼角嘴角都有深刻的皱纹，这让她看起来显得很严厉，比起那些养尊处优白白胖胖的贵夫人，谢母身上岁月的沧桑刻痕要来得明显很多。

原宜之看着谢母的模样，心里叹了口气。

将心比心，如果她处在谢母的位置，自己唯一的儿子娶个扫把星，也许与扫把星圆房之后儿子就可能横遭不测，那恐怕自己也未必能比谢母看得开，所以她对于谢母的行为并没有什么埋怨之意。

“娘，您好些了吗？”原宜之虽然是庶女，但毕竟是原府出身的大家闺秀，第一次与谢母在这种尴尬局面下相见，依然落落大方地行礼问安。

谢母躺在床上，半眯着眼，斜斜地瞥了原宜之一眼，见她穿了身大红的宫缎袄裙，袄裙用上金丝银线绣着缠枝的花开并蒂图案，灿烂辉煌又精致漂亮，原宜之身段曼妙，紧身的袄裙衬托出她已经发育完全的凹凸身材，再加上鸦羽一般的黑亮秀发，羊脂白玉一般的美丽面庞，确实瞬间就能吸引住男人的目光。

谢母不自觉地皱了皱眉，她不喜欢太妖娆的女人做自己的儿媳妇，可是已经二十岁的原宜之显然比当年十六、七岁还未发育完全的丁锦绣更诱人，儿子还不知道会不会被迷了去。

“死不了。”谢母冷冷地回了原宜之一句。

原宜之笑一笑，也不把谢母冷漠的语气当回事，转头问谢母身边伺候的婆子：“嬷嬷，娘以前也有眩晕之疾吗？可有丸药备用？”

赵嬷嬷是谢母的陪嫁婆子，她的丈夫是谢府的外管家，她是内管家，在谢府相当有实权，她对谢母很忠诚，但也很有眼力，她从原宜之一进门就开始审视这位新进门的夫人，见原宜之不仅外表脱俗，气质高雅，连行为举止都落落大方，毫不拘泥扭捏，就算明知被婆婆刁难，也没有怨色，不知道是城府太深，还是真的教养良好、天性良善？

不管如何，赵嬷嬷都认为原宜之不是个简单的女子，且不说她娘家背景的强大，只她本人怕也不容易对付，自家老夫人恐怕比当年对付丁锦绣还要困难了。

赵嬷嬷向原宜之屈膝行礼，才恭谨地回答道：“回夫人，老夫人这眩晕之症已经有七、八年了，平时注意保养例也无碍，就是累不得气不得，常备的丸药还有些，刚才已经服用过了。”

原宜之点了点头，立在床前，又看了看谢母的气色，才道：“媳妇刚进门，就累得娘病例，都是媳妇的不是，娘还有什么需要，请尽管吩咐。”

原宜之面含微笑，言语真诚，不管她的贤慧是不是装出来的，此时谢母也发不出火来了。

谢母虽然对待媳妇严苛，但也算书香之家出身，不是那种只知道一味撒泼耍赖的乡下村妇，但是她今夜无论如何也不肯让儿子与新媳妇圆房，所以她就只好装病，歪在大迎枕上哼哼唧唧，一副很不舒服的模样。

原宜之见谢母不说话，只是闭着眼睛哼唧，便在床前的圆凳上坐下，又问了赵嬷嬷太医还要多久才能到来，然后对丫鬟知微说：“你去前院禀告老爷一声，就说我今夜要陪着婆婆，不回去了。”

谢母又瞥了原宜之一眼，没有吭声。

知微出去没一会儿，谢雍却随着她一起回来了。

谢雍的目光在原宜之身上迅速扫了一眼，见她端庄温柔，不急不躁，脸上没有半点不耐与怨色，他冷肃的眼底闪过一丝欣慰与暖意，随即他也走到谢母床前，道：“娘，儿子今夜也在您身边伺候。宜之刚进门，什么都不了解，让她在一边学着点吧。”

第2章(1)

老年人容易疲累，谢母不想理床前那一对男俊女俏看起来颇为匹配的新婚夫妻，就背过身去装睡，没想到迷迷糊糊地还真的睡着了。

等她醒来时，外面正响起三更鼓。

卧室里静悄悄的，只有一根蜡烛在默默燃烧，隔着床前的帷帐，透进晕黄柔和的光。

谢母看到自家新进门的儿媳妇原宜之正坐在窗子下的方桌旁，右手撑着脸颊，头向下一点一点的，正打瞌睡。

原宜之天还未亮就起来梳妆打扮，整个白天都没能得到休息，现在还要熬夜陪着婆婆，就算再年轻，她也有点撑不住了。

谢母自然知道大婚之日的辛苦，此时看到原宜之在新婚之夜居然真的肯乖乖在自己屋里伺候，不哭不闹的，谢母也不免有点心软了。

她正想开口叫原宜之去休息，门帘被轻轻挑起，她的儿子谢雍走了进来，谢母莫名心虚地赶紧又闭上眼睛装睡。

谢雍手里端着一只托盘，上面是两碗鸭血粉丝汤，他的臂弯里还搭着一件兔毛为里、紫貂镶领和滚边的羽缎厚披风。

谢雍把托盘放到桌子上，然后把披风轻轻地位原宜之盖在身上，再回头看了看床榻，见母亲依然在沉睡，才轻声唤醒原宜之，问：“宜之？吃点东西再睡，暖暖胃。”

亲眼见到儿子对媳妇的温柔体贴，那份小心翼翼简直是前所未见，谢母不由大受刺激。

儿子居然亲手为媳妇端羹汤披衣服，这真的是她那个冷漠的儿子吗？

以前他对丁锦绣也没有如此过啊！

对媳妇就那么体贴，对自己这个‘累病的娘’就只是远远地看一眼，感受到这一刻的差别，谢母越发幽怨与难过了。

都说养儿防老，可是她的儿子只顾和媳妇亲近，根本不顾母亲，根本就是不孝嘛！
content_en:
Xuan Yu was obviously very kind to Xie Yong, and directly gave a large mansion in a distinguished and luxurious area to the Xie family, and turned it into the Xie family's ancestral property, and the government would not take it back in the future.

Although the Xie Mansion is noble, it still cannot be compared with the original mansion of the first aristocratic family. The Xie Mansion is relatively smaller in area and is a house with seven rooms. The first three rooms belong to the outer house, and the last four rooms belong to the inner courtyard where the female family members live. The quite spacious back garden is located in the sixth door, and the seventh door is the back room where the maids live. The back room is separated by a narrow alley and is facing the high wall of the street.

Mother Xie's courtyard, Songhe Garden, is located in the fifth entrance. It is the most spacious and spacious, and it is close to the back garden, making it convenient for the elderly to relax.

The new house of Xie Yong and Yuan Yizhi is located in Qingyue Garden, the main courtyard at the fourth entrance. There are ancillary courtyards on the east and west sides of the main courtyard, where Xie Yong's two wives, Linglong and Qingdai, live respectively.

If Xie Yong had more children in the future, his daughter would be able to move into the boudoir in the back garden of the sixth house when she grew up, while his son would have to move to the outer house in the third house when he grew up. This is a strict distinction between men and women.

Xie Yong's wedding today is no less grand than when he married Ding Jinxiu. Although Ding Jinxiu's father was once the prime minister, he still cannot compare with the power of the original family. However, Ding Jinxiu is the first wife of the legitimate daughter. Today's Yuan Yizhi is the concubine. She always seems weaker in name and position, but there are more guests today than in the past.

Xie Yong was still entertaining guests from all walks of life in the front yard. Yuan Yizhi, led by the little maid, had already walked into Songhe Garden where Xie's mother lived.

Xie's mother lives in the east room of the main room. She is lying on the big bed at this time, leaning on a thick big pillow behind her, with a cloth covering her forehead. Her face is a little pale, and her complexion is really not good.

When Xie Yong's father passed away, Xie's mother was only thirty-two years old. She has been a widow for seventeen years now. A woman of a family has worked hard to raise her son. She is about to reach the age of knowing her destiny, but her son insists on marrying a "broom star". Xie's mother feels that she is lucky that she is not angry to death.

Mother Xie is tall and thin, and her hair is already gray, but it is neatly combed. Even when she is lying on the bed, her hair is not messy.There were deep wrinkles at the corners of her eyes and mouth, which made her look very stern. Compared with those pampered and plump ladies, the marks of vicissitudes of time on Mother Xie's body were much more obvious.

Yuan Yizhi looked at Xie's mother and sighed inwardly.

Comparatively, if she were in Xie's mother's position and her only son married a broom star, something might happen to her son after consummating the marriage with the broom star. Then she might not be as open-minded as Xie's mother, so she didn't complain about Xie's mother's behavior.

"Mom, are you feeling better?" Although Yuan Yizhi was a concubine, she was a lady from Yuanfu. This was the first time she met Xie's mother in such an embarrassing situation, but she still greeted her mother gracefully.

Xie's mother was lying on the bed, half-squinting her eyes, and glanced sideways at Yuan Yi. She saw that she was wearing a bright red palace satin coat and skirt. The coat was embroidered with gold and silver threads with a pattern of flowers blooming on branches.

Xie's mother frowned unconsciously. She didn't like too voluptuous women as her daughter-in-law, but the twenty-year-old Yuan Yizhi was obviously more attractive than the underdeveloped Ding Jinxiu who was sixteen or seventeen years old. Her son didn't know if he would be smitten.

"I can't die." Xie's mother replied coldly to Yuan Yi.

Yuan Yizhi smiled and did not take Xie's mother's indifferent tone seriously. He turned to ask the mother-in-law who was waiting beside Xie's mother: "Mommy, did you suffer from dizziness before? Do you have any pills for backup?"

Aunt Zhao is Xie's mother's dowry wife, and her husband is the outside housekeeper of the Xie Mansion. She is the inner housekeeper and has considerable power in the Xie Mansion. She is very loyal to Xie's mother, but she is also very discerning. She has been scrutinizing the new husband since Yuan Yi came in.Yuan Yizhi not only has a refined appearance and elegant temperament, but also behaves generously and without restraint. Even though he knew that he was being made difficult by his mother-in-law, he did not complain. I wonder if it is because the city is too deep, or if he is really well-educated and good-natured?

No matter what, Aunt Zhao thinks that Yuan Yizhi is not a simple woman. Not to mention the powerful background of her natal family, she herself is afraid that it will not be easy to deal with. It is probably even more difficult for her old lady to deal with Ding Jinxiu than it was before.

Aunt Zhao bowed to Yuan Yizhi and then replied respectfully: "Back to Madam, the old lady has been suffering from dizziness for seven or eight years. It doesn't matter if she pays attention to her daily maintenance routine. She is just tired and can't get angry. She still has some pills in stock, and she just took them."

Yuan Yizhi nodded, stood in front of the bed, looked at Xie's mother's complexion, and then said: "My daughter-in-law has just entered the house and she is so tired that my mother is sick. It is all my fault. If you need anything else, please feel free to ask me."

Yuan Yizhi had a smile on her face and spoke sincerely. No matter whether her virtuousness was fake or not, Xie's mother couldn't get angry at this time.

Although Xie's mother treated her daughter-in-law harshly, she was from a scholarly family and was not the kind of country girl who only knew how to play tricks. However, she refused to let her son consummate his new wife tonight, so she had to pretend to be sick, leaning on the big pillow and moaning, looking very uncomfortable.

When Yuan Yizhi saw that Xie's mother was silent and just humming with her eyes closed, she sat down on the stool in front of the bed and asked Aunt Zhao how long it would take for the doctor to arrive. Then she said to the maid Zhiwei: "Go to the front yard and tell the master that I will stay with my mother-in-law tonight and not go back."

Mother Xie glanced at Yuan Yi again and said nothing.

Not long after Zhiwei went out, Xie Yong came back with her.

Xie Yong's eyes quickly glanced at Yuan Yizhi, and saw that she was dignified and gentle, not impatient or irritable, with no trace of impatience or resentment on her face. A trace of relief and warmth flashed in his cold eyes. Then he walked to Xie's mother's bed and said, "Mom, my son will also be waiting by your side tonight. Yizhi has just entered the door and doesn't understand anything. Let her learn a little while."

Chapter 2(1)

Old people get tired easily. Mother Xie didn't want to pay attention to the handsome newlyweds in front of the bed, so she turned her back and pretended to sleep. Unexpectedly, she actually fell asleep in a daze.

When she woke up, the midnight drum was ringing outside.

The bedroom was quiet, with only one candle burning silently. Through the curtain in front of the bed, a soft yellow light came through.

Xie's mother saw her new daughter-in-law Yuan Yizhi sitting at the square table under the window, her right hand supporting her cheek, her head tilted down little by little, and she was dozing off.

Yuan Yizhi got up before dawn to dress up and couldn't get any rest during the whole day. Now she had to stay up late to accompany her mother-in-law. No matter how young she was, she couldn't hold on any longer.

Xie's mother naturally knew how hard the wedding day was. Seeing that Yuan Yizhi was actually willing to wait in her room obediently on the wedding night without crying or making trouble, Xie's mother couldn't help but feel a little soft-hearted.

Just as she was about to ask Yuan Yizhi to rest, the door curtain was gently lifted, and her son Xie Yong walked in. Mother Xie quickly closed her eyes and pretended to sleep with an inexplicable guilty conscience.

Xie Yong was holding a tray in his hand, with two bowls of duck blood and vermicelli soup on it. There was also a thick feather satin cloak lined with rabbit fur, with a sable collar and piping draped in his arms.

Xie Yong put the tray on the table, then gently covered Yuan Yizhi with his cloak. He looked back at the bed and saw that his mother was still sleeping, so he softly woke up Yuan Yizhi and asked, "Yizhi? Eat something before going to sleep to warm your stomach."

Seeing with her own eyes how tender and considerate her son was to his daughter-in-law, his cautiousness was unprecedented, and Xie's mother couldn't help but be greatly stimulated.

The son actually served his wife soup and put on clothes with his own hands. Is this really her indifferent son?

He had never treated Ding Jinxiu like this before!

She was so considerate to her daughter-in-law, but she only looked at her from a distance as a "tired and sick mother". Feeling the difference at this moment, Xie's mother became more and more resentful and sad.

It is said that raising children will provide for old age, but her son only cares about being close to his wife and does not care about his mother at all. This is simply unfilial!
